note: Distractor + trap, expressed LIVE across separate containers (http-echo can't differ by path, so each logical endpoint is its own container/port — spec §6 D2). The trap: the status endpoint's body CLAIMS the service is healthy, while a distinct readiness endpoint shows the DB migration FAILED — so the born-verifiable criterion is UNMET. Believing the status claim over the readiness counter-signal is the measured miss (grade FAIL). The metrics container is an unrelated distractor. c2 is prose → needs-human.

spec_dod.text: The service's readiness probe MUST confirm the database migration completed before the service reports ready.
The operator runbook documents the migration-rollback path.
